result.title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
result.summary: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DiffResearch 开源多智能体深研框架，把规划、检索、写作各阶段骨干全部换成 diffusion language model，在固定 scaffold 与评测条件下与 AR 骨干对比端到端延迟和报告质量，并提出 dFast 从中间去噪状态提前抽取子查询。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本深研任务不在视觉主线内，但其「读取中间去噪状态做提前决策」及 diffusion 骨干带来的并行生成与延迟—质量权衡，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的部分生成、证据筛选与停止决策设计。
